title: The Human Immunodeficiency Virus and Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017
full_text: Act is under updation and will be uploaded shortly. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201716 Act Number: 16 Enactment Date: 2017-04-20 Act Year: 2017 Short Title: The Human Immunodeficiency Virus and Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 Long Title: An Act to provide for the prevention and control of the spread of Human Immunodeficiency Virus and Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome and for the protection of human rights of persons affected by the said virus and syndrome and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Medical Health Enforcement Date: 10-09-2018 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare) Location: Uttar Pradesh Notification: 10th September, 2018 vide Notification No. S.O. 4715(E) dated 10th September 2018, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
